programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E04 9 Crimes Sookie joins Alcide at an engagement party for his former fiancée; Eric is given a deadline to locate Bill; Andy gets a promotion; Franklin takes Tara on a road trip; Sam brokers a deal with Tommy; Bill procures dinner for Russell and Lorena.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E05 Trouble Alcide and Sookie turn to a packmaster for advice on how to deal with Russell's minions; Tara considers a proposal from Franklin; Joe Lee breaks his promise to Sam and Tommy; Jason meets a mysterious girl; an heirloom reminds Eric of his past.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E06 I Got a Right to Sing the Blues Bill's fate lies in Lorena's hands; Tara tries to stave off Franklin's advances; Tommy finds it difficult to leave his family; Jessica puts Pam's teachings into practice; Jason and Crystal's romance hits a snag; Russell visits Louisiana.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E07 Hitting the Ground Sookie goes to extremes in her attempt to save Bill; Sam infiltrates a dog-fighting ring; Jason tries to uncover the truth about Crystal; Summer makes a play for Hoyt's affections; Debbie vows revenge on Alcide; Eric tries to get information.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E08 Night on the Sun Sookie rethinks her relationship with Bill; Russell plots his next move; Jessica and Bill reconcile; Jason tries to save Crystal; Lafayette gets a visit from his mother; Alcide must deal with a family emergency.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E09 Everything Is Broken Eric is confronted about the Magister's disappearance; Russell vows revenge against his foes; Bill uncovers the truth about Sookie's identity; Sam is distressed by Tommy's attitude; Tara encounters a new ally; Hoyt confronts his true feelings.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E10 I Smell a Rat Bill warns Sookie about the dangers she will face; Sam recalls dark memories; Eric takes precautions; Arlene turns to Holly for help; Jason deals with the unexpected; Jessica is torn between Tommy and Hoyt.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E11 Fresh Blood Bill tries to earn Sookie's trust; Eric tempts Russell; Sam embraces his dark side; Hoyt and Jessica take their romance to the next level; Arlene puts her future in the hands of a goddess; Lafayette struggles with new demons.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S03 E12 Evil Is Going On Eric plots his revenge against Russell; Sookie considers a new life without Bill; Tara discovers some surprising news about Sam; Jason finds a new calling; Lafayette turns to Jesus for help; Hoyt hopes for a future with Jessica.

programme.title: True Blood
programme.desc: S04 E01 She's Not There Sookie journeys away from Bon Temps; Eric and Bill try to charm the human public; Tara finds refuge; Sam bonds with his own; Hoyt and Jessica debate; Jesus urges Lafayette to join a coven; Terry attempts to alleviate Arlene's fears.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 1
programme.desc: After their car breaks down in an eerie small town, a young couple is forced to spend the night in a remote cabin. Panic ensues as they are terrorized by three masked strangers who strike with no mercy and seemingly no motive. - Madelaine Petsch, Froy Gutierrez, Gabriel Basso, Hayato Isomura, Yukino Kishii (Drama, Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Pearl
programme.desc: Trapped on an isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the watch of her mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide. - Mia Goth, David Corenswet, Tandi Wright, Matthew Sunderland, Emma Jenkins-Purro (Comedy, Drama, Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: MaXXXine
programme.desc: Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past. - Mia Goth, Elizabeth Debicki, Moses Sumney, Michelle Monaghan, Bobby Cannavale (Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Les Misérables
programme.desc: After 19 years as a prisoner, Jean Valjean (Hugh Jackman) is freed by Javert (Russell Crowe), the officer in charge of the prison workforce. Valjean promptly breaks parole but later uses money from stolen silver to reinvent himself as a mayor and factory owner. Javert vows to bring Valjean back to prison. Eight years later, Valjean becomes the guardian of a child named Cosette after her mother's (Anne Hathaway) death, but Javert's relentless pursuit means that peace will be a long time coming. - Hugh Jackman, Russell Crowe, Anne Hathaway, Amanda Seyfried, Eddie Redmayne (Drama, Historical drama, History, Movie, Musical)

programme.title: City Dump: The Story of the 1951 CCNY Basketball Scandal
programme.desc: TV footage, home movies and interviews chronicle the game-fixing scandal at the City College of New York. - Liev Schreiber, Marty Glickman, Nat Holman, Marvin Kalb (Basketball, Documentary, History, Show, Special)

programme.title: Shot Heard 'Round the World
programme.desc: Bobby Thomson's dramatic home run ends the 1951 National League baseball playoff between the New York Giants and the Brooklyn Dodgers. - Liev Schreiber, Ralph Branca, Bobby Thomson, Larry King (Baseball, Documentary, Show, Special)

programme.title: Magnolia
programme.desc: On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter will each become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story. - Jason Robards, Julianne Moore, Tom Cruise, Philip Baker Hall, Philip Seymour Hoffman (Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Eyes Wide Shut
programme.desc: After Dr. Bill Hartford's (Tom Cruise) wife, Alice (Nicole Kidman), admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head. - Tom Cruise, Nicole Kidman, Sydney Pollack, Marie Richardson, Rade Šerbedžija (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: American Made
programme.desc: Barry Seal, a TWA pilot, is recruited by the CIA to provide reconnaissance on the burgeoning communist threat in Central America and soon finds himself in charge of one of the biggest covert CIA operations in the history of the United States. The operation spawns the birth of the Medellin cartel and almost brings down the Reagan White House. - Tom Cruise, Domhnall Gleeson, Sarah Wright Olsen (Adventure, Comedy drama, Documentary, Movie)

programme.title: The Age of Adaline
programme.desc: Adaline Bowman has miraculously remained a youthful 29-years-of-age for nearly eight decades, never allowing herself to get close to anyone lest they discover her secret. However, a chance encounter with a charismatic philanthropist named Ellis Jones reawakens Adaline's long-suppressed passion for life and romance. When a weekend with Ellis' parents threatens to expose the truth, Adaline makes a decision that changes her life forever. - Blake Lively, Michiel Huisman, Kathy Baker, Harrison Ford, Ellen Burstyn (Drama, Fantasy, Movie, Romance)

programme.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes, Brian Dennehy, Jesse Bradford, Vondie Curtis-Hall (Drama, Movie, Romance)

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: In this adaptation of the classic Emily Brontë novel set in 19th-century England, wealthy young Cathy Earnshaw (Merle Oberon) shares a loving bond with Heathcliff (Laurence Olivier), a poor childhood friend who now works in her stables. Unfortunately, things become complicated when the affluent Edgar Linton (David Niven) decides to pursue Cathy, and Heathcliff leaves out of resentment. Though Heathcliff returns with a self-made fortune, he realizes he may have lost Cathy in his absence. - Merle Oberon, Laurence Olivier, David Niven, Flora Robson, Donald Crisp (Drama, Movie, Romance)

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back. - Michael B. Jordan, Hailee Steinfeld, Miles Caton, Jack O'Connell, Wunmi Mosaku (Action, Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Nerdy college student Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg) has survived the plague that has turned mankind into flesh-devouring zombies because he's scared of just about everything. Gun-toting, Twinkie-loving Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson) has no fears. Together, they are about to stare down their most horrifying challenge yet: each other's company. Emma Stone and Abigail Breslin co-star in this double-hitting, head-smashing comedy. - Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone, Abigail Breslin, Amber Heard (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Horror)

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Zombie slayers Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock leave the confines of the White House to travel to Graceland in Memphis, Tenn. Along the way, they encounter other post-apocalyptic warriors and a group of survivors who find refuge in a commune. The scrappy fighters must now rely on their wits and weapons more than ever as they soon find themselves in a relentless battle against smarter, faster and seemingly indestructible zombies. - Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone, Abigail Breslin, Zoey Deutch (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Dark comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Undertone
programme.desc: The host of a popular paranormal podcast is sent hidden messages within anonymous recordings, unleashing a demonic presence that is impossible to escape. - Nina Kiri, Adam DiMarco, Michèle Duquet, Keana Bastidas, Jeff Yung (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn's full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence. However, when the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles finds himself pitted against the other Spiders. He must soon redefine what it means to be a hero so he can save the people he loves most. - Shameik Moore, Hailee Steinfeld, Brian Tyree Henry, Luna Lauren Vélez, Jake Johnson (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children)

programme.title: Diego Maradona
programme.desc: On July 5, 1984, Diego Maradona arrives in Naples for a world-record fee. The world's most celebrated soccer icon and the most passionate but dangerous city in Europe are a perfect match for each other. - Diego Armando Maradona, Pelé, Dalma Maradona, Diego Maradona, Daniel Arcucci (Biography, Documentary, Movie)

programme.title: Magic & Bird: A Courtship of Rivals
programme.desc: A history traces the competition between basketball players Larry Bird and Earvin "Magic" Johnson. - Earvin "Magic" Johnson, Larry Bird, Pat Riley, Magic Johnson, Liev Schreiber (Basketball, Documentary, Drama, Show, Special)

programme.title: Gran Turismo
programme.desc: The true story of a team of unlikely underdogs -- a working-class gamer, a former race car driver, and an idealistic motorsport executive -- who risk it all to take on the most elite sport in the world. - David Harbour, Orlando Bloom, Archie Madekwe, Djimon Hounsou, Darren Barnet (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: The Last Samurai
programme.desc: Capt. Nathan Algren (Tom Cruise) is an American military officer hired by the Emperor of Japan to train the country's first army in the art of modern warfare. As the government attempts to eradicate the ancient Samurai warrior class in preparation for more Westernized and trade-friendly policies, Algren finds himself unexpectedly affected by his encounters with the Samurai, which places him at the center of a struggle between two eras and two worlds. - Tom Cruise, Ken Watanabe, Timothy Spall, Tony Goldwyn, Hiroyuki Sanada (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, War)

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: Dockworker Ray Ferrier (Tom Cruise) struggles to build a positive relationship with his two children, Rachel (Dakota Fanning) and Robbie (Justin Chatwin). When his ex-wife, Mary Ann (Miranda Otto), drops them off at Ferrier's house, it seems as though it will be just another tension-filled weekend. However, when electromagnetic pulses of lightning strike the area, the strange event turns out to be the beginning of an alien invasion, and Ferrier must now protect his children as they seek refuge. - Tom Cruise, Dakota Fanning, Miranda Otto, Justin Chatwin, Tim Robbins (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: The Revenant
programme.desc: While exploring the uncharted wilderness in 1823, frontiersman Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) sustains life-threatening injuries from a brutal bear attack. When a member (Tom Hardy) of his hunting team kills his young son (Forrest Goodluck) and leaves him for dead, Glass must utilize his survival skills to find a way back to civilization. Grief-stricken and fueled by vengeance, the legendary fur trapper treks through the snowy terrain to track down the man who betrayed him. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hardy, Domhnall Gleeson, Anne Consigny, Frédéric Pierrot (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Mystery)

programme.title: Greenland
programme.desc: John Garrity, his estranged wife and their young son embark on a perilous journey to find sanctuary as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. Amid terrifying accounts of cities getting leveled, the family experiences the best and worst in humanity. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate, last-minute flight to a possible safe haven. - Gerard Butler, Morena Baccarin, Roger Dale Floyd, David Denman, Hope Davis (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction)

programme.title: Greenland 2: Migration
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a comet strike that decimated most of the planet, the Garrity family must leave the safety of their Greenland bunker to traverse a shattered world in search of a new home. - Gerard Butler, Morena Baccarin, Roman Griffin Davis, Tommie Earl Jenkins, Trond Fausa Aurvåg (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets. - Sydney Sweeney, Amanda Seyfried, Brandon Sklenar, Michele Morrone, Indiana Elle (Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Saltburn
programme.desc: A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer. - Barry Keoghan, Jacob Elordi, Rosamund Pike, Richard E. Grant, Alison Oliver (Comedy, Comedy drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Perfect Weapon
programme.desc: An exploration of the rise of cyber conflict as the primary way that nations now compete with and sabotage one another; interviews with top military, intelligence and political officials; includes on-the-ground reporting from the front lines. - John Stimac, Dmitri Alperovitch, Seth Rogen, Hillary Clinton, Will Hurd (Crime, Documentary, Show, Special)

programme.title: Kill Chain: The Cyber War on America's Elections
programme.desc: From voter registration to counting ballots, data security expert Harri Hursti examines how hackers can influence and disrupt the U.S. election system. - Harri Hursti, Amy Klobuchar, James Lankford, Ron Wyden, Mark Warner (Action, Adventure, Documentary, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Insurrectionist Next Door
programme.desc: Alexandra Pelosi turns her camera on people who stormed the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021; through interviews conducted over two years, Pelosi talks to individuals charged with crimes for their participation in the unprecedented events of the day. (Documentary, Interview, Show, Special)

programme.title: Batman Begins
programme.desc: A young Bruce Wayne travels to the Far East, where he's trained in the martial arts by Henri Ducard, a member of the mysterious League of Shadows. When Ducard reveals the League's true purpose -- the complete destruction of Gotham City -- Wayne returns to Gotham intent on cleaning up the city without resorting to murder. With the help of Alfred, his loyal butler, and Lucius Fox, a tech expert at Wayne Enterprises, Batman is born. - Christian Bale, Michael Caine, Liam Neeson, Katie Holmes, Gary Oldman (Action, Adventure, Crime, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
programme.desc: It's been nearly two years since Superman's colossal battle with Zod devastated the city of Metropolis. The loss of life and collateral damage left many feeling angry and helpless, including crime-fighting billionaire Bruce Wayne. Convinced that Superman is now a threat to humanity, Batman embarks on a personal vendetta to end his reign on Earth, while the conniving Lex Luthor launches his own crusade against the Man of Steel. - Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Amy Adams, Jesse Eisenberg, Gal Gadot (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Batman
programme.desc: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis. - Robert Pattinson, Zoë Kravitz, Jeffrey Wright, Colin Farrell, Paul Dano (Action, Adventure, Crime, Crime drama, Movie)

programme.title: Betrayal: A Father's Secret
programme.desc: A tale of earth-shattering discoveries, a victim's bravery and a woman's quest to reclaim her life against all odds. (Crime, Documentary)

programme.desc: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Stranded on Earth, aliens Beldar and Prymaat of Remulak try suburbia with their teenage daughter, Connie.

programme.title: Turtle Power: The Definitive History of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The release of Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird's groundbreaking comic in 1984 leads to a worldwide phenomenon.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise encounter sabotage on the way to peace talks with the Klingon Federation.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When a man claiming to be Fester, the missing brother of Gomez Addams, arrives at the Addams' home, the family is thrilled. Morticia begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life.

programme.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
programme.desc: A household threatens to burst at the seams when the marriage of two widowed parents creates a family of 18 children.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Picard (Patrick Stewart), Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and the others set off to stop the half-robot Borg from sabotaging the first warp drive flight in 2063.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: To win the heart of his beloved, a young man (Charlie Cox) ventures into the realm of fairies to retrieve a fallen star (Claire Danes).

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons. - William Shatner, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, George Takei, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Living in exile on the planet Vulcan, the ragtag former crew of the USS Enterprise steal a starship after receiving a planetary distress call from Earth: a space probe has entered into orbit around Earth, disabled global power on the planet and evaporated the oceans. Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Catherine Hicks, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. - Haley Joel Osment, Jude Law, Frances O'Connor, Brendan Gleeson, Sam Robards (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Bran Nue Dae
programme.desc: A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey. - Rocky McKenzie, Jessica Mauboy, Ernie Dingo, Geoffrey Rush, Magda Szubanski (Drama, Comedy, Musical)

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: This animated comedy finds Tommy Pickles (E.G. Daily) trying to return his baby brother to the hospital after being warned by his mean-spirited friend, Angelica (Cheryl Chase), that once his new sibling is born his parents won't care about him. But, soon after they embark on the mission, Tommy and his friends lose their way in the woods and get into trouble with a pack of wild monkeys who have escaped from the circus. The kids begin to think that maybe things weren't so bad at home after all. - E.G. Daily (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Of the three Grace children, Jared has always been thought of as the troublemaker. So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick. - Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger, Mary-Louise Parker, David Strathairn, Joan Plowright (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Drama, Action)

programme.title: Love Means Zero
programme.desc: Tennis coach Nick Bollettieri's relentless desire to win at all costs leads to the destruction of an important relationship. (Documentary)

programme.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown. - Kelly Kruger, Brendan Penny, Tom Arnold, Lisa Hartman, Tina Simmons (Comedy)

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Members (Andre Gower, Robby Kiger) of a monster fan club meet Count Dracula, Wolfman, Frankenstein, the Mummy and Gill Man. - Andre Gower, Robby Kiger, Stephen Macht, Duncan Regehr, Tom Noonan (Horror, Adventure)

programme.title: View From the Top
programme.desc: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Christina Applegate, Mark Ruffalo, Candice Bergen, Joshua Malina (Comedy, Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Monster Summer
programme.desc: A mysterious force disrupts Noah and his friends' summer fun. They team up with a retired police detective to embark on a monstrous adventure to save their island. - Mel Gibson, Lorraine Bracco, Mason Thames, Kevin James, Nora Zehetner (Adventure, Horror)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. - Patrick Swayze, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Joseph Mazzello, Seth Mumy, David Marshall Grant (Fantasy)

programme.title: Our Ghosts
programme.desc: Hiding in the attic of his former apartment, a widowed and jobless father tries to scare the new tenant so he can live there once again. - Michele Riondino, Hadas Yaron, Paolo Pierobon, Orlando Forte, Alessandro Haber (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Smoke Signals
programme.desc: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. - Adam Beach, Evan Adams, Irene Bedard, Gary Farmer, Tantoo Cardinal (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
programme.desc: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement. (Documentary, Music)

programme.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
programme.desc: Combining unheard audio recordings, dramatic reconstructions and personal archives, filmmakers Peter Middleton and James Spinney trace Charlie Chaplin's meteoric rise from the slums of Victorian London to the heights of Hollywood superstardom. - Charlie Carter, Sarah Lawn, Jo Price, Matthew Wolf (Documentary)

programme.title: Nancy Drew
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Nancy Drew (Emma Roberts) accompanies her father (Tate Donovan) on a business trip to Los Angeles and stumbles across evidence in the case of a movie star's long-unsolved death. The young heroine's resourcefulness and integrity are put to the test in the glamorous -- but sometimes treacherous -- world of Hollywood. - Emma Roberts, Josh Flitter, Max Thieriot, Rachael Leigh Cook, Tate Donovan (Children, Mystery, Adventure)

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: In the 23rd century, the Starship Enterprise is dispatched to the scene of a giant energy field about to engulf two ships. Capt. Kirk (William Shatner) averts calamity, but is exposed to the field and presumed dead. Years later, the Enterprise's new commander, Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart), learns that one of the disaster's survivors, Dr. Soran (Malcolm McDowell), plans to enter the field by destroying a neighboring star. Picard now must collaborate with an unlikely ally in order to stop him. - Patrick Stewart, William Shatner, Malcolm McDowell, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
programme.desc: In the long-running animated series' second feature film, the focus is on the show's perennial second banana, Chuckie (Christine Cavanaugh). Dads Stu (Jack Riley) and Chaz (Michael Bell) are unexpectedly sent to Euro-Reptarland in Paris, where the animatronic dinosaurs they built for the amusement park are malfunctioning, much to the displeasure of manager Coco La Bouche (Susan Sarandon). When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Free Birds
programme.desc: Pardoned by the president, a lucky turkey (Owen Wilson) named Reggie gets to live a carefree lifestyle, until fellow fowl Jake (Woody Harrelson) recruits him for a history-changing mission. Jake and Reggie travel back in time to the year 1621, just before the first Thanksgiving. The plan: Prevent all turkeys from ever becoming holiday dinners. Unfortunately, the two birds encounter colonist Myles Standish (Colm Meaney), out to capture feathered friends for all the hungry Pilgrims. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Now that Dracula has opened the Hotel Transylvania's doors to humans, things are changing for the better; however, Drac is secretly worried that his half-human grandson, Dennis, isn't showing his vampire side. So, while Mavis and Johnny are away, Drac enlists his friends to help him put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp. But things really get batty when Drac's cantankerous, old-school dad pays an unexpected visit. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.desc: S1E1 - Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals' DNA from birth; check out the bowerbird's mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crab's traffic-dodging prowess and the sockeye salmon's uphill swimming skills. (Documentary, Animals)

programme.title: Africa's Hunters - Teenage Pride
programme.desc: S1E5 - Adolescent lions face many challenges. (Nature, Documentary)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.desc: Narrated by Grammy Award-winning artist, Seattle native, and lifelong Mariners fan Macklemore, this documentary looks back at the team that helped keep baseball in the Pacific Northwest. (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Network Presents - Junior
programme.desc: Stars and legends from across the sports and entertainment landscape discuss Ken Griffey Jr.'s generational talent, which transcended baseball and made him one of sports' most famous athletes. (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Network Presents - The Swingin' A's
programme.desc: Examines the tense relationship that existed between controversial owner Charlie Finley and the A's roster of superstars that won three World Series titles from 1972-74. Features interviews with Hall of Famers Rollie Fingers and Reggie Jackson. - Rollie Fingers, Reggie Jackson (Baseball)

programme.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
programme.desc: Three Boy Scouts (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) join forces with a tough cocktail waitress (Sarah Dumont) to save their once-peaceful town from a zombie invasion.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: The Lego Movie
programme.desc: An ordinary LEGO figurine Emmet, thought to be the key to saving the world, is accompanied by a fellowship of strangers embarking on a quest to vanquish a tyrant bent on a terrible deed.

programme.title: End of Sentence
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland.

programme.title: Rebel in the Rye
programme.desc: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye.

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: A bickering couple make one last effort to save their marriage by turning their arguments into songs and forming a band.

programme.title: Gone Baby Gone
programme.desc: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to the life he has abandoned.

programme.title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: The first of three dark tales involves resentful student Bellingham (Steve Buscemi) looking to an Egyptian mummy for help in settling some scores. Then, hit man Halston (David Johansen) is contracted to kill a cat that has terrorized and even killed members of an extremely wealthy family. Lastly, struggling artist Preston (James Remar) witnesses a demon commit a bizarre murder on a city street, but agrees to keep it a secret when the devilish being promises wealth in return for his silence. - Deborah Harry, Christian Slater, David Johansen, William Hickey, James Remar (Horror)

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop." - David Keith, Drew Barrymore, George C. Scott, Freddie Jones, Heather Locklear (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning. - Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh, Natasha Lyonne, Paul Hipp, Anita Pallenberg (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. - Eric Roberts, Liam James Collins, Dallas Hart, Jonathan Peacy, Arthur Sylense (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Noah's Arc: Jumping the Broom
programme.desc: Gay couple Noah (Darryl Stephens) and Wade (Jensen Atwood) invite their friends along for a weekend of revelry when they decide to get married in Martha's Vineyard. - Darryl Stephens, Jensen Atwood, Gary LeRoi Gray, Rodney Chester, Christian Vincent (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater. - Gillian Jacobs, Jemaine Clement, Josh Wiggins, Forrest Goodluck, Khloe Janel (Comedy)

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: When David Greene (Brendan Fraser) receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule. - Brendan Fraser, Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell, Randall Batinkoff, Andrew Lowery (Drama)

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress. - Tsemaye Bob-Egbe, Natey Jones, Jo Wheatley, Alexandra Burke, Michael Junior Onafowokan (Drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. - Elias Koteas, Briana Middleton, Bridget Wareham, Justin Nurse, Reuben Frederick Gear (Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: All the World Is Sleeping
programme.desc: A young mother in New Mexico sinks deeper into addiction while struggling to care for her daughter. - Melissa Barrera, Jackie Cruz, Kristen Gutoskie, Luis Bordonada, Lisandra Tena (Drama)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. - Agnes Bruckner, Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey, D.J. Cotrona, Rick Cramer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Spontaneous
programme.desc: When students in their high school inexplicably start to explode, seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last. As an unexpected romance blossoms between them, they soon discover that when tomorrow is no longer promised, they can finally start living for today. - Katherine Langford, Charlie Plummer, Yvonne Orji, Hayley Law, Rob Huebel (Dark comedy, Horror, Romance)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. - Garrett Hedlund, Hamish Linklater, Brittany Snow, Christian Convery, Tramell Tillman (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another. - Fionn O'Shea, Robert Aramayo, Erin Kellyman, Louis Hofmann, Jodi Balfour (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. - Channing Tatum, Alex Pettyfer, Matthew McConaughey, Cody Horn, Olivia Munn (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. - Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, Vince Vaughn, Jeremy Piven, Ellen Pompeo (Comedy)

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: Kevin (Lance Bass) has everything going for him, but his lifelong lack of confidence keeps him from recognizing love and happiness -- even if it's sitting next to him. When Kevin meets the girl of his dreams, Abbey, on Chicago's L train, they connect immediately, but he lets this golden opportunity slip away by not having the courage to ask her for her name and number. Unable to find her, or forget her, Kevin and his buddies launch a massive campaign to locate Abbey. - Lance Bass, Joey Fatone, Emmanuelle Chriqui, GQ, James Bulliard (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Tzi Ma, Ken Leung (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, John Lone, Zhang Ziyi, Roselyn Sánchez (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Hiroyuki Sanada, Yûki Kudô, Max Von Sydow (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Black Lotus
programme.desc: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend. - Rico Verhoeven, Frank Grillo, Roland Møller, Rona-Lee Shim'on, Kevin Janssens (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. - John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, Bruce Willis, Ving Rhames (Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Dark comedy, Movie)

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Officer K (Ryan Gosling), a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years. - Ryan Gosling, Harrison Ford, Ana de Armas, Dave Bautista, Robin Wright (Action, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Crime, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, C. Ernst Harth, Olivia Taylor Dudley (Crime, Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco. - Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ken Watanabe, Elizabeth Olsen, Juliette Binoche, Bryan Cranston (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: My Cousin Vinny
programme.desc: New York lawyer Vinny has never won a case. When his teenage cousin Bill and his friend Stan are accused of murder in a backwater Alabama town, it's up to the nervous Vinny to save him from jail, even though he's only ever tried personal injury cases before, and none of them successfully. - Joe Pesci, Marisa Tomei, Ralph Macchio, Mitchell Whitfield, Fred Gwynne (Comedy, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. - Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, Vince Vaughn, Jeremy Piven, Ellen Pompeo (Comedy, Movie)

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. - Jennifer Aniston, Jason Sudeikis, Will Poulter, Emma Roberts, Ed Helms (Action, Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Movie)

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart. - Julianne Hough, Diego Boneta, Russell Brand, Alec Baldwin, Tom Cruise (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Music, Musical)

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney.. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears. - Tom Cruise, Rosamund Pike, Robert Duvall, Richard Jenkins, David Oyelowo (Action, Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: MobLand - A Different Corner (New)
programme.desc: Licking wounds and turning on each other after fleeing Frankie's assault, Seraphina goes all in, pitching the Harrigans on a global power play; Maeve and Harry square off over crossed lines. - Tom Hardy, Pierce Brosnan, Helen Mirren, Paddy Considine, Joanne Froggatt (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Series)

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) springs into action after the arrest of Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders), an Army major accused of treason. Suspecting foul play, Jack embarks on a mission to prove that the head of his old unit is innocent. After crossing paths with the law, Reacher must now go on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers. - Tom Cruise, Cobie Smulders, Aldis Hodge, Danika Yarosh, Patrick Heusinger (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Crimes of the Future
programme.desc: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs. Meanwhile, a mysterious group tries to use Saul's notoriety to shed light on the next phase of human evolution. - Viggo Mortensen, Léa Seydoux, Kristen Stewart, Scott Speedman, Welket Bungué (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Kiss the Girls
programme.desc: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova. - Morgan Freeman, Ashley Judd, Cary Elwes, Alex McArthur, Tony Goldwyn (Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. - Harrison Ford, Anne Archer, Patrick Bergin, Thora Birch, Sean Bean (Action, Adventure, Crime, Crime drama, Drama)

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. - John Goodman, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, John Gallagher, John Gallagher Jr., Douglas M. Griffin (Drama, Horror, Movie, Mystery, Science Fiction)

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. - Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon, Josh Brolin, Hailee Steinfeld, Barry Pepper (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Western)

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Now that Dracula has opened the Hotel Transylvania's doors to humans, things are changing for the better; however, Drac is secretly worried that his half-human grandson, Dennis, isn't showing his vampire side. So, while Mavis and Johnny are away, Drac enlists his friends to help him put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp. But things really get batty when Drac's cantankerous, old-school dad pays an unexpected visit. - Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg, Selena Gomez, Kevin James, Steve Buscemi (Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy, Family)

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes." - Ashley Tisdale, Simon Rex, Erica Ash, Ashley French, Gracie Whitton (Comedy, Movie)

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known. - Dakota Fanning, Kathryn Hunter, Mary McCormack, Rachel Blanchard, Devyn Nekoda (Horror, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Dutchman
programme.desc: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. - André Holland, Kate Mara, Zazie Beetz, Stephen McKinley Henderson, Aldis Hodge (Drama, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. - Russell Crowe, Karen Gillan, Marton Csokas (Comedy, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood. - Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Emma Watson, Ray Winstone, Anthony Hopkins (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Historical drama, Movie)

In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy. - Gerard Butler, Lena Headey, David Wenham, Dominic West, Vincent Regan (Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon, having already defeated every army in Greece, uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy, the last kingdom preventing his control over the Aegean Sea. - Brad Pitt, Eric Bana, Orlando Bloom, Brian Cox, Sean Bean (Action, Adventure, Historical drama, Movie, War)

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. - Denzel Washington, Pedro Pascal, Ashton Sanders, Orson Bean, Bill Pullman (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in 1860's New York. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Daniel Day-Lewis, Cameron Diaz, Jim Broadbent, John C. Reilly (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Historical drama, History)

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. - Russell Crowe, Karen Gillan, Marton Csokas (Comedy, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: A Simple Plan
programme.desc: While in the woods near their small town, upstanding local Hank Mitchell (Bill Paxton), his dim brother Jacob (Billy Bob Thornton) and their friend Lou (Brent Briscoe) discover a crashed plane with two things in it -- a dead pilot, and a stash of more than four million dollars. Although Hank is reluctant to keep the money, Jacob and Lou convince him otherwise, and they devise a plan to split the fortune. Things quickly go wrong, however, dramatically affecting the trio and those around them. - Bill Paxton, Billy Bob Thornton, Brent Briscoe, Bridget Fonda, Jack Walsh (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: Career thief Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) is about to mastermind a nearly impossible theft that will require his joining forces with a clever young accomplice (Edward Norton). The unlikely alliance, arranged by Nick's longtime friend and fence, Max (Marlon Brando), interrupts Nick's plan to retire from crime and settle down with his fiancée, Diane (Angela Bassett). Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone. - Robert De Niro, Edward Norton, Angela Bassett, Marlon Brando, Gary Farmer (Action, Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie)

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. - Elisabeth Shue, Michael Byrne, Phillip Noyce, Val Kilmer, Rade Šerbedžija (Action, Adventure, Movie, Romance, Science Fiction)

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them. - Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Carrie Fisher, Bruno Kirby, Steven Ford (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel. - Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Parker Posey (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance)

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city. - Brad Pitt, Morgan Freeman, Gwyneth Paltrow (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller)

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. - Idris Elba, Matthew McConaughey, Tom Taylor, Claudia Kim, Fran Kranz (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction)

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. - Harrison Ford, Anne Archer, Patrick Bergin, Thora Birch, Sean Bean (Action, Adventure, Crime, Crime drama, Drama)

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend. - Jon Hamm, Kyle MacLachlan, Marcia Gay Harden, Roy Wood Jr., Annie Mumolo (Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery)

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter. - Charly Luske, Ferry Doedens, Liza Sips, Selena Gomez, Adam Sandler (Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy, Family)

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2

programme.desc: S8E13 - Across the planet are places where nature behaves in ways that seem to defy explanation, forests where people vanish, deserts where signals fail, caves filled with toxic air and mountains no one dares to climb; are these merely extreme environments… or evidence that Earth still contains hidden realms where the rules of nature become dangerously unknown? (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Curses Unleashed
programme.desc: S5E3 - Many people are afraid of walking into a cursed place or touching a reportedly cursed object; they look at whether curses are real and how they are brought into existence. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - The Underground World
programme.desc: S2E5 - Exploring the center of the Earth. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Monsters Among Us
programme.desc: S6E10 - Since the dawn of humanity, tales of monstrous creatures lurking in the shadows have sparked both fascination and fear; discussing the potential that these stories have elements of reality to them. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Mind Over Matter
programme.desc: S8E5 - The human mind is home to all our thoughts, hopes, dreams, and memories; the organ we call the brain not only keeps us alive, it allows us to interpret and experience the incredible world we live in. programme.title: The UnXplained - Mysteries of the Underground
programme.desc: S7E18 - Beneath our feet lie hidden ancient tunnels, sacred caves and shadowy passages into a world of darkness shaped by nature, carved by man and steeped in myth; seeing if the underground realms are mere remnants of the past, or they guard secrets. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Alien Close Encounters
programme.desc: S8E15 - For decades, UFO sightings have been reported by military pilots, civilians and even entire communities, and while many have been explained, some continue to defy conventional answers; from close encounters with strange beings to alleged abductions, mysterious metallic spheres and reports of an entire town terrorized by what witnesses described as an alien attack, the evidence remains tantalizing but incomplete. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Mighty Kingdoms Unearthed
programme.desc: S8E6 - Throughout civilization there are many kingdoms and mighty empires that have risen, only to one day fall. And for some of them-like the Inca that built Machu Picchu-their eventual demise remains a mystery. What can we discover from clues left behind by these once great empires? Could the Vikings, using their longships and traits as skilled navigators, have travelled farther into America than what we are led to believe? (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Evil Places
programme.desc: S1E1 - Deadly forests, haunted houses, and mountains where visitors never return alive; a look at what constitutes an evil place and whether these locations are imbued with dark energy that is currently beyond understanding. (Paranormal, Documentary)

programme.title: The UnXplained - Strange Technology

programme.desc: S2E14 - Twisting rivers, large lakes and massive oceans cover most of the planet; for centuries, people have wondered about activity deep beneath the surface; as technology advances, humanity pushes farther into deep ocean waters, mapping and uncovering new species and biomes; this interest in global waters raises new inquiries regarding cursed man-made lakes and isolated future discoveries beneath Antarctic ice. (Documentary, Paranormal)

programme.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Shadow Societies (New)
programme.desc: S2E15 - We've all wondered about mysterious societies that operate in the shadows, holding the potential to shape our daily lives. But is the massive reach of these shadowy groups a fabrication—an easy target for people to assign blame—or something much more real? Are the interests of the many truly controlled by the select few? It is an unnerving thought that unaccountable, unseen forces are actively steering our lives, potentially for the worse. (Documentary, Paranormal)

programme.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Lost Fortunes (New)

And could the opulent city of Xanadu described in the travels of Marco Polo exist in the jungles of Asia? (Documentary, Paranormal)

programme.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Powerful Objects

programme.title: Scream 3

programme.title: Piranha

programme.title: Sound of Violence
programme.desc: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain.

programme.title: The Foreigner
